description: Customer-specific handling instructions have changed over time, and the current operating guidance is no longer consistent across dispatcher notes, route sheets, and field memory. All customer names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 41-year-old customer operations manager trying to stop repeated instruction drift
user_profile.context: No single catastrophic error has happened, but the same customer exceptions keep being relearned instead of retained accurately
user_profile.communication_style: Consistency-minded and operational, wants one current source of truth for customer-specific rules

fact_sheet.fact: Apex Industries' customer account number is APX-88401.
Veridian Plaza's service address is 1550 N. Commerce Drive, Westgate, IL 60185.
Gourmet Grocers' primary on-site contact is Sarah Jenkins, the store manager.
Starlight Theaters has a service contract for twice-weekly cardboard recycling pickup, scheduled for Tuesdays and Fridays.
The loading dock gate code for Veridian Plaza is *7335#, valid from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Saturday.
Apex Industries requires all organic waste bins to be pressure washed on-site during the last Friday pickup of each month.
Gourmet Grocers requires a signature from the on-duty manager, logged in the RouteOptix app, for all compost pickups.
All glass recycling bins from Starlight Theaters must be collected before 8:00 AM to avoid interference with their morning food deliveries.
Apex Industries' used solvent drums (UN 1993) must be handled exclusively by a HazMat-certified driver; Kenji Tanaka is currently the only one assigned.
Veridian Plaza's recycling compactor, model Marathon RJ-250SC, must be locked out using key #VP-02 before any service or swap.
Do not collect the blue bin with serial number B-45921 from Gourmet Grocers; it is for their internal bottle deposit returns only.
For Starlight Theaters, any overflow cardboard must be flattened and stacked neatly against the west wall of the service alley, not left loose.
The single source of truth for all current customer instructions is the 'Customer Notes' section of the Ops Portal.
All customer instruction changes must be submitted via the 'Instruction Update Form' on the Ops Portal and approved by Brenda Chen.
A daily pre-shift briefing is held at 5:30 AM at the main depot to review any instruction changes from the previous 24 hours.
Any service deviation must be reported by the driver within 15 minutes via the 'Service Alert' function in the RouteOptix mobile app.
The last system-wide audit of all customer handling instructions was completed on October 15, 2023.
On November 28, 2023, a driver attempted to use the old gate code for Veridian Plaza, causing a 45-minute service delay.
A $75 service credit was issued to Starlight Theaters on December 5, 2023, because a pickup was missed due to a route sheet error.
The instruction for Apex Industries' pressure washing was officially added to their service agreement on August 1, 2023, under work order #WO-9154.
The login URL for the Ops Portal is https://ops.ecocyclesolutions.internal/login.
The shared network drive for historical, paper-based route sheets is located at \\ecocycle-fs01\archives\routesheets.
The current, mandatory version of the RouteOptix mobile app for all drivers is v3.4.2.
All instruction updates are logged with timestamps in a Git repository named 'customer_instructions_log' on the internal GitLab server.
Brenda Chen is the Customer Operations Manager and her office is room 201B at the main depot.
The primary dispatcher for industrial accounts, including Apex Industries, is Dave Miller at extension 215.
Field Supervisor Maria Garcia's mobile number for urgent on-site issues is 555-821-9904.
Driver Kenji Tanaka's employee ID is E-782, and his HazMat certification expires on June 30, 2025.
Truck #17, a Mack LR Electric with license plate 8T4-3B9, is assigned to the downtown route covering Gourmet Grocers and Starlight Theaters.
The 8-yard front-load dumpster at Veridian Plaza has a serial number of FLD-09288.
The compost bins provided to Gourmet Grocers are 64-gallon Toter brand bins, colored green.
The handheld scanner model used for logging service completions is the Zebra TC57.

user_needs.description: What is the single source of truth for all current customer instructions?
What is the official procedure for submitting and approving changes to customer instructions?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After establishing the source of truth, the user's next logical concern is how to properly maintain and govern it.

user_needs.description: Can you describe the service failure that occurred at Veridian Plaza on November 28, 2023?
What are the current, correct gate access instructions for Veridian Plaza?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After learning about a past failure related to an old gate code, the user will immediately want to confirm the current, correct code to prevent a recurrence.

user_needs.description: What is the special handling requirement for Apex Industries' used solvent drums?
Who is the designated HazMat-certified driver for Apex Industries, and what is their employee ID?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning that a specific certification is required for a customer, the next operational question is who on the team is qualified to perform the task.

user_needs.description: What are the specific instructions regarding the compost pickup signature and the blue bin at Gourmet Grocers?
What is the required procedure for a driver to report a service deviation?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Reviewing a past service failure (like the Veridian Plaza delay) naturally leads to questions about the correct procedure for reporting such issues when they happen.

user_needs.description: Where on the network can I find the archive of old, paper-based route sheets?
How are updates to customer instructions logged for tracking purposes?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning about the formal process for changing instructions, an operations manager focused on consistency would want to know how those changes are logged and audited.
